methodology.revenue_estimate: Current-year reported quarterly revenue annualized by reported months; fallback to latest annual revenue when YTD data unavailable.
methodology.dividend_estimate: Estimated revenue × scenario NPM × scenario DPR ÷ shares outstanding; estimated yield = DPS ÷ latest price.
methodology.payment_pattern: Actual historical dividend payment dates from Yahoo Finance over three years; months are historical windows, not guaranteed future payment dates. Multiple payments in a year are flagged as a possible interim/instalment pattern and must be verified against official IDX/KSEI/issuer announcements.
methodology.caveat: Exploratory estimate only. Fiscal periods, special dividends, share changes, corporate actions and incomplete Yahoo data may distort results. Validate against official filings.
